interview.hardest_part: Defeating bosses in later floors (3+) with accumulated damage and complex attack patterns that require precise spatial reasoning and reaction timing from static screenshots
interview.likely_failure: Floor 3-4 boss fights or high-density enemy rooms where I take fatal damage due to delayed reaction from turn-based play, inability to judge precise timing windows, or failure to recognize and dodge complex bullet patterns
interview.helpful_mechanics: Turn-based input allowing deliberate decision-making; fixed seed enabling pattern learning across the single attempt; item pickups being automatic on contact; doors closing until enemies are cleared giving clear objectives; roguelike structure with discrete rooms and floors providing measurable progress checkpoints
interview.harmful_mechanics: Real-time enemy movement and projectiles compressed into static screenshots losing velocity and trajectory information; tears requiring sustained directional input while I can only hold for 0.5s steps; no healing mechanic visible making every hit permanent; boss attack patterns requiring frame-precise dodging that turn-based play cannot achieve; enemy variety and attack patterns I cannot predict from a single screenshot; room layouts and enemy spawns unknown until entered
